about_the_game:
1.From that day on, only darkness remained in my brother's and my world... Since then, under my brother's protection, I embarked on a journey through the darkness.

2.Open chests along the path to randomly obtain Food, Water, or the "Summon Brother" skill. Use Food or Water to restore Health. Using the Summon Brother skill consumes Soul Essence to deal massive damage to monsters.

3.Randomly encounter various monsters during the journey. Monsters perform bullet hell attacks. Defeating monsters grants Soul Essence and has a chance to drop a Meteor Egg. Using skills consumes Soul Essence. Opening a Meteor Egg has a chance to grant a Pet. Pets also perform bullet hell attacks.

4.Each step taken consumes 1% Health and grants 1 Experience Point. Upon reaching full Experience, the character Level increases, which fully restores Health (100%) and increases Max Health by 10%. While resting, Health regenerates by 1% per second. During rest, clicking the number buttons (1/2/3/4/5) below the BOSS character allows you to listen to adult-oriented audio stories.

5.Defeating each monster grants 20% BOSS Challenge Progress. When the progress reaches 100%, players can engage in a timed BOSS challenge. Successfully defeating the BOSS increases its level, while failure leaves the BOSS level unchanged.

6.The BOSS unleashes more spectacular bullet hell attacks, temporarily defeats pets, and summons Bomb Dragon Knights that attack both allies and foes. During this phase, the player's brother will lock onto the BOSS—click the sight icon to summon him and deal massive damage to the BOSS. Defeating the BOSS rewards a Heart Peach. Opening the Heart Peach grants a "Phone." Tap the phone in the lower-left corner to watch adult anime videos, earning 10 Soul Essence every 10 seconds during playback.

content_descriptors.notes: Certain in-game scenes contain adults-only sexual content, such as "revealing clothing" and "sexual content".
